name: Ken
source:
Ken is the main character of this story. He is the one that awakens one day with amnesia, and struggles to understand his current living circumstances in the mansion.

Ken's a generally carefree and gentle man. He depends on Shiori and Ryunosuke to help him through his new, everyday life in the mansion. With their help, he slowly comes to an understanding of who he is, and what he enjoys, but does feel some conflict over who the "him" before he lost his memories was, compared to the "him" of the present.

Regardless, he's always trying his best for Shiori's sake. However, it's difficult for him to rid himself of the doubts and worries that come with his lack of memores.

"This time... please indulge me. I'll try my best to live up to the person I've become, and hopefully, I'll regain my memories soon."

[From [url=http://akimieroworks.wix.com/home#!manor-of-amnesia/c1857]official site[/url]]
